title: Ngati Yo Sungula Leyi Halatiweke Hi Mavondzo
intro: Anakanya hi masiku yo sungula ya vumunhu, loko misava hinkwayo yi ri ndyangu wun’we. U hlalela loko magandzelo mambirhi ma vekiwa emahlweni ka Allah — yin’wana yi amukeriwile, yin’wana yi ariwile. Mavondzo ma dzima timitsu embilwini, naswona nxungeto wu hleveteriwa hi vukarhi. Leswi landzelaka swi ta siya mfungho ematin’wini hilaha ku nga heriki, naswona hambi ku ri xinyenyana lexitsongo xi ta va mudyondzisi.
clues: Ndzi wa ndyangu wo sungula swinene emisaveni.
Ndzi nyikele gandzelo eka Allah, kambe ra mina a ri amukeriwanga kasi gandzelo rin’wana a ri amukeriwa.
Ndzi vulavule hi mavondzo naswona ndzi xungetile ku dlaya vutomi.
Ndzi endle ku dlaya ko sungula loku nga lulamangiki emisaveni.
Ndzi vone ximanga xi ri karhi xi khwaxa ehansi leswaku xi ndzi komba ndlela yo tumbeta ntsumbu.
Ndzi sale ndzi tele ku tisola naswona ndzi ve exikarhi ka lava hluriweke hikwalaho ka leswi mavoko ya mina ma swi endleke.

identity.label: Xana Ndzi mani?
options: Kabil (Kayini), n’wana wa Adamu
Samiri, muendli wa rhole
Namrud, mufumi wa tihanyi loyi a kanetaka na Ibrahim
Azara, muendli wa swifaniso
Kan'an, n'wana wa Nuh loyi a nwileke

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku dlayiwa ka makwavo hikwalaho ka mavondzo endzhaku ka nyiko leyi ariweke
Ku aka xihondzo lexi tlakukeke leswaku u languta matilo
Ku vumba rhole ra nsuku ra vugandzeri
Ku lava tafula leri hangalakeke ri huma etilweni
Ku rhangela vuthu ra tindlopfu ku lovisa Kaaba
trial.answer: Ku dlayiwa ka makwavo hikwalaho ka mavondzo endzhaku ka nyiko leyi ariweke

Nhonga leyi hundzukeke nyoka

location.answer: Ximanga lexi khwaxaka misava ku kombisa ku lahliwa

options: U ve loyi a tisolaka naswona a ri exikarhi ka lava hluriweke

U mitiwe hi misava hi xuma

outcome.answer: U ve loyi a tisolaka naswona a ri exikarhi ka lava hluriweke

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
